headline: A Rp79.7tn SUN auction book keeps the front-end rally going (1Y −6.6bp to 6.73%) and the 10Y edges down to 7.67% despite a 10bp US sell-off on hot CPI, but a weaker rupiah pushes the flow signal deeper into sell-off (−0.77)
summary: PHEI's IGSYC kept rallying from the front: the 1Y fell 6.6bp to 6.728% (13.8bp lower this week), the 2Y 5.4bp to 6.953% and the 3Y 3.1bp to 7.123%, while the 5Y slipped only 0.7bp to 7.409% and the 10Y 1.1bp to 7.673%, with 15–30Y down about 1.5bp. That bull-steepened the 2s5s to 45.6bp from 40.9bp and lifted the 2s5s10s fly to 19bp, and the 1Y–5Y are again the lowest of the ten PHEI days stored. Benchmark FR0109 gave back 7.6bp to 7.327% and is now on the curve, while FR0108 (7.584%) and FR0107 (7.613%) stay about 8–9bp rich. The fitted PBS curve cheapened at 2Y (4.1bp over IGSYC, cheapest stored) and sits on IGSYC at 5Y; the retail fit stayed 10.7bp rich at 5Y, and AAA 3Y held at 49.6bp over as corporate curves again moved with IGSYC.
drivers: Auction demand anchored the front end

Tuesday's SUN auction drew Rp79.71tn of bids for a Rp30tn target, more than double MNC's forecast; the government took Rp35tn (bid-to-cover 2.28x), with FR0110 (2032) at 7.44% and FR0111 (2037) at 7.68%, the two 2026–27 SPN bills covered 9.4x and 6.7x, and no award in the new 20-year FR0113. DJPPR data show foreigners bid Rp18.01tn and won Rp10.6tn, 30% of the total, so foreign demand at the auction is published; who bought in the secondary market on Wednesday is not, and domestic bank buying of short paper is a hypothesis.
Hot US CPI pushed Treasuries to 5%; INDOGBs ignored it

US October CPI rose 0.4% m/m (f 0.3%) and core 0.3% (f 0.2%), and a soft 10-year auction followed; the US 10Y closed 10bp higher at 4.98% and the 2Y about 18bp higher. At the 1-year daily beta of 0.33 that implied +3.3bp for the INDOGB 10Y, yet it fell 1.1bp, so Treasuries explain none of today's move; INDOGBs have followed large US moves in the same direction 73% of the time, so this is an outlier rather than a broken link. The INDOGB − UST spread narrowed to 269bp (92nd percentile of 52 weeks), a nominal pick-up before currency risk.
Rupiah and equities softened on the Fed and politics

JISDOR rose 0.53% to 18,154 and spot closed at 18,149 as the dollar firmed; the JCI fell 0.21% to 5,115.04 ahead of MSCI's November review (results 05:00 WIB Nov 12; not the Standalone decision, which is due by end-June 2027), with foreigners net selling Rp287bn in the morning session. PDIP said all 110 of its MPs back a parliamentary motion (HMP) that could lead to impeachment of Vice President Gibran, a day after he signalled he may resign; bonds did not react, but it keeps political risk live.

The daily Bond Flow Signal fell to −0.77 from −0.66 (Nov 10 restated from −0.64), so the sell-off episode that began Oct 7 is open for an 18th session at +52.0bp on the 10Y. The 10Y trend part (z +2.08, +58.2bp over 20 sessions) and the JCI part (z −1.67, −15.75%) drove it, the rupiah part stayed mildly bearish (z +0.40), and the spread part, the one bond-bullish input, weakened to z +1.05 as Treasuries sold off.
data: US 10Y to 4.98% and the 2Y up ~18bp; December Fed-hike odds rose, which narrows BI's room to stay on hold.
Bids Rp79.71tn (p Rp31.09tn); awarded Rp35tn vs Rp30tn target; FR0110 7.44%, FR0111 7.68%
Strong demand, though awarded yields were 5–26bp above the previous auction (MNC); FR0113 not awarded.
Soft consumption argues against hikes for growth reasons; BI's price-expectation index rose, though.
Kept a December Fed hike in play; a hike would narrow BI's room.
Up despite intervention. My read, not a BI commitment: BI can keep smoothing the rupiah near 18,000–18,200 before it has to hike.
A beat led by government spending: no growth case for an early cut.
Softer than expected: inflation does not force BI's hand; the rupiah does.
view: The auction showed there is cash for SBN at these yields, and it is going to the front end, where the 1Y now sits under my 6.75% no-chase line and under 100bp over the BI-Rate, while the 10Y is stuck in a 7.6–7.7% range by supply, the rupiah and the political noise; MSCI (Nov 12), US PPI (Nov 13) and BI (Nov 17–18) are the tests. The daily Bond Flow Signal is −0.77, in sell-off, with the 10Y trend (z +2.08), the JCI (z −1.67) and the rupiah (z +0.40) bearish and only the 269bp Treasury spread, 28.6bp above its 130-day average (z +1.05), bullish; the Oct 7 episode is open at +52.0bp. On the daily build since June 2022 the signal scores a Sharpe of 0.75 outright and 0.87 hedged against Treasuries, but sell-off calls were right only 51% of the time over the next 20 sessions (rally calls 58%; hedged 62% and 51%), and the average 10Y move after a sell-off call was −1.8bp; the weekly build scores 0.42 and 0.57, and the US-trend variants reach 0.73 and 0.78 on the weekly build but were chosen after the fact and are not live; all are in-sample back-tests. Treasuries explain only about 3bp of the 52bp four-week rise (weekly beta −0.23), so the trend rests on the residual — the rupiah, BI, MSCI and politics — not on the Fed. I stay neutral on the 10Y with a 7.55–7.80% two-week range: my underweight rule needs the signal below −0.5 and the 10Y above 7.75%, and only the first holds. On the curve, the front-end rally looks stretched; I would rather wait to buy FR0109 back near 7.60% or add 10s20s steepeners on FR0113 supply than chase 1–2Y.

buckets.name: Front end 1–2Y vs BI-Rate
buckets.why: The IGSYC 1Y fell 6.6bp to 6.728%, 98bp over the 5.75% BI-Rate, the lowest of ten stored days (10th percentile, average 110bp), and the 2Y 5.4bp to 6.953%; the 3M (0.25Y) is 6.30% and the 1M 6.21%, 121bp over the 5.00% deposit facility. Auction SPN bills drew 9.4x and 6.7x cover. Previous call: the 1Y broke through the 6.75% no-chase line; the 7.10% add level was not reached (37bp away).
buckets.call: Neutral. Add 1–2Y only at 1Y 7.10% or after a BI hike with JISDOR below 18,000; at 6.73% the 1Y prices an easing BI has not signalled.

buckets.name: Belly 5Y (FR0109 / PBS040)
buckets.why: The IGSYC 5Y slipped 0.7bp to 7.409%, the lowest of ten stored days (10th percentile, average 7.499%), 11.2bp lower this month; the 2s5s10s fly rose to 19bp from 14bp (30th percentile, average 27bp). FR0109 reversed 7.6bp of yesterday's 12.3bp rally to 7.327% and is now on the curve; PBS040 at 7.419% is 13.9bp cheap. The outright entry (FR0109 7.60–7.70%) was not filled; the PBS040 switch stays closed after yesterday's stop.
buckets.call: No position. Buy FR0109 at 7.60–7.70% after a BI hike or with JISDOR below 18,000; target 7.35%, stop 7.95%.

buckets.name: 10Y outright
buckets.why: The IGSYC 10Y fell 1.1bp to 7.673%, 95th percentile of the past year (172 days, average 6.78%) and 5bp under the 7.724% high of Nov 4, while the US 10Y rose 10bp. The signal is −0.77, but the underweight rule also needs the 10Y above 7.75%, so it is still not triggered. FR0108 at 7.584% is 8bp rich to the curve; FR0111 cleared at 7.68% in the auction.
buckets.call: Neutral. Underweight if the signal stays below −0.5 and the 10Y closes above 7.75%; tactical long only above 7.85% (stop 8.05%) or once the signal is above 0 with JISDOR below 18,000.

buckets.name: 10s20s curve (FR0108 vs FR0107)
buckets.why: IGSYC 10s20s is 2.6bp (90th percentile of ten stored days, average 1.3bp, range 0.1–2.9bp), so the curve is near its steepest stored but the range is tiny. The benchmark spread FR0107 − FR0108 narrowed to 2.9bp from 4.5bp, 7.9bp short of the −5bp re-entry. FR0113 (2047) drew only Rp1.13tn and was not awarded, so 20Y supply is deferred, not cancelled.
buckets.call: Wait. Re-enter the FR0108/FR0107 steepener duration-weighted at −5bp or lower, target +5bp, stop −12bp; an FR0113 reopening could cheapen the 20Y first.

buckets.name: PBS sukuk vs FR
buckets.stance: FR over PBS034 at the long end
buckets.why: The fitted PBS 5Y is on IGSYC (0.0bp; 78th percentile of nine stored days, average −2.0bp), the 2Y 4.1bp over (cheapest stored) and the 10Y 2.6bp through; the fit rests on four series (level −5.7bp, slope 15.6bp), so confidence is limited. PBS034 fell 1.0bp to 7.592% and stays about 10bp rich, PBS038 rallied 6.8bp to 7.662%, PBS030 rose 3.6bp. The switch-back condition (PBS034 5bp cheap) is not met; the position stays open.
buckets.call: Hold FR over PBS034; switch back once PBS034 is 5bp cheap to IGSYC. PBS040 at about 14bp cheap is value for buy-and-hold accounts, not a trade.

buckets.name: Corporate credit (AAA 3Y)
buckets.why: PHEI's AAA 3Y fell 2.8bp to 7.619%, 49.6bp over IGSYC (44th percentile of nine stored days, average 50.8bp). AA (85.9bp), A (155.6bp) and BBB (235.5bp over AA, average 244.1bp) were again unchanged versus the government curve, which suggests repricing off IGSYC rather than trading. Nine days is a thin base; the add level (AAA 3Y past 70bp) was not reached.
buckets.call: Hold AAA/AA; add only if AAA 3Y widens past 70bp. Avoid BBB until the rupiah and politics settle.

buckets.name: Retail SBN 5Y (ORI/SR)
buckets.why: The fitted retail curve is 10.7bp through IGSYC at 5Y (89th percentile of nine stored days, average −14.2bp) and 10.4bp over at 2Y; the 21-series fit has a steep 80bp slope, so part of this is fit artefact. Secondary spreads run from 56bp rich (ORI026T3) to 43bp cheap (ORI027T3); ORI026T6 is 7.526%, 31bp over. ST017 (open to Dec 2) floors at 6.95% (2Y) and 7.05% (4Y), now on the IGSYC 2Y (6.95%) and below the 4Y (7.28%).
buckets.call: For new money, FR0109 or PBS040 give daily liquidity; ST017 suits hold-to-maturity buyers who want BI-hike upside. Buy secondary retail only at the cheap end (ORI026T6, ~31bp over IGSYC).

watch: Next: MSCI's November index review (05:00 WIB Thu Nov 12; changes effective Dec 1), US PPI (Fri Nov 13), Indonesia's October trade balance (mid-November), the DPR's handling of the HMP motion on the Vice President, then BI's board meeting (Nov 17–18); JISDOR above 18,200 or a 10Y close above 7.75% would trigger the underweight, while a rupiah back below 18,000 would push a BI hike out.
